description:
PEGA (Mandatory) 
 As a Lead, you are responsible for managing a small team of analysts, developers, testers or engineers and drive delivery of a small module within a project (Delivery/Maintenence/Testing) 
 You may serve as entry level specialist with expertise in particular technology/industry domain/a process / application / product. 
 You are responsible for functional/technical track of a project. 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
